workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects after ordered Runtime authority and Worker Claimed were durably established. Q-20260819-01 verified that Codex now projects role files into a typed bounded override set: behavioral fields and selected capability reductions may change, while parent-owned permissions, provider configuration, approval reviewer, MCP servers, base URL and notifications remain inherited; managed feature requirements remain effective, symlinked user role files are rejected, and cold-resumed workers traverse the same bounded role path with provider-routing regression coverage. This is a demonstrated configuration-boundary authority invariant, not complete delegation security. Q-20260819-02 verified that Codex's root-only gated send_user_message_async tool emits a typed AgentMessage with delivery=Async, awaits ItemStarted/ItemCompleted emission, then returns accepted=true so the turn continues; the integration test proves the visible text is not re-injected into the next model request as a synthetic assistant message, while protocol/app-server/history structures preserve the delivery classification. This does not prove end-to-end external delivery, acknowledgement, retry, cancellation or global ordering. Q-20260819-03 verified that the MCP TypeScript SDK separates OAuth refresh from token persistence: only refreshAuthorization remains in the refresh catch, successful new tokens are passed to provider.saveTokens afterward, and saveTokens rejection now propagates instead of silently falling through to REDIRECT; tests cover the persistence failure, unchanged refresh-error recovery and warnings for deliberate reauthorization. This is fail-visible refresh persistence, not OAuth transactionality or rollback. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 均完成持久核验后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260819-01 核验了 Codex 现在把 Role 文件投影为类型化的受限 Override 集：行为字段与部分能力收缩可以改变，但父级拥有的权限、Provider 配置、Approval Reviewer、MCP Server、Base URL 与通知配置保持继承；Managed Feature Requirement 继续有效，符号链接形式的用户 Role 文件会被拒绝，Cold Resume 后的 Worker 也走同一受限 Role 路径，并有 Provider Routing 回归测试。该结论证明的是配置边界上的权限不扩张不变量，不是完整委派安全。Q-20260819-02 核验了 Codex 的 Root-only、受 Feature 与 Model Support 双重门控的 send_user_message_async 工具：它生成 delivery=Async 的类型化 AgentMessage，等待 ItemStarted/ItemCompleted 发出后返回 accepted=true，使当前 Turn 继续；集成测试证明这条用户可见文本不会作为合成 Assistant Message 重新注入下一次 Model Request，同时 Protocol、App-server 与 Thread History 路径保留 Delivery 分类。该机制不能扩大解释为端到端外部送达、用户确认、重试、取消或全局顺序保证。Q-20260819-03 核验了 MCP TypeScript SDK 对 OAuth Refresh 与 Token Persistence 的失败域分离：只有 refreshAuthorization 保留在 Refresh Catch 中，成功取得的新 Token 在其后交给 provider.saveTokens；saveTokens 拒绝现在直接向调用方传播，不再静默落入 REDIRECT。回归测试覆盖持久化失败、原有 Refresh Error Recovery 以及主动重新授权路径的警告。该机制是 Refresh Persistence 的 Fail-visible 修正，不是 OAuth 事务性或回滚。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。
